Kansas: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Kansas on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 13, 2026. Last day to register to vote, or to update your registration for a change of name or address.
  • Advance voting (in person and by mail): October 14, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Counties may start in-person advance voting on October 14, and every county must offer it by October 27. Mail ballots also go out starting October 14. In-person advance voting ends at noon on November 2. Check with your county election office for times and locations.
  • Last day for your county to receive your mail ballot application: October 27, 2026. Your county election officer must receive the application by the close of business on the Tuesday before Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. in most counties, and some counties may set different hours. If you are in line when polls close, you can still vote.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

State

Governor / Lieutenant Governor

A 4-year term. This is an open seat because Gov. Laura Kelly (Democrat) is term-limited. Governor and lieutenant governor run on a joint ticket. Masterson's running mate is Jeff Klemp, and Holscher's is KC Ohaebosim.

Third-party or independent tickets are unconfirmed. Check your sample ballot.
